    • getStringRepresentation

      String getStringRepresentation()
      Returns:
      A quick (and maybe wrong) default representation of the content. I should be ok for text/plain type content.

    • getContentType

      String getContentType()
      Returns:
      The content type ("text/plain", "image/gif", "text/html", etc) of the content.

    • getBasePathKey

      String getBasePathKey()
      Returns:
      If the content is addressable through an application (ie NewsItem), the resource key to where the app is mounted.

    • getAccessPath

      String getAccessPath()
      Returns:
      The path used to access the content (HTTP or file, but protocol is not included) TODO: Make this a bit clearer (include protocol, URL-like??)

    • getWikiWordPath

      String getWikiWordPath() throws ContentProcessorException

      The path to access a WikiWord which appears at this content level. It will depend in the way This content gets accessed

      ContentProcessorException

      InputStream getInputStream() throws ContentProcessorException

    • getLinks

      Collection getLinks() throws ContentProcessorException

      The collection of other contents dependent on this (ie, Components for a NewsItem).
      Throws:
      ContentProcessorException - If they cant be found.

    • getLinkByName

      Content getLinkByName(String name) throws ContentProcessorException
      Parameters:
      name - The name of the Content
      Returns:
      A Content dependent on this which is keyed by the supplied name.
